title: Logical Recepies - Buttons
description:
Steve needs one CUBIC METER of wood for one tiny button.
Let’s fix that!
body:
Steve is **very** inefficient when it comes to crafting.
Just think of it. **ONE CUBIC METER OF WOOD** is only one tiny button.
So lets fix that!
This datapack gives the player 64 (closest to the mathamatically correct 86) buttons per craft.
